problem: A customer-facing contact identity correction introduced Dutch strings that were not yet present in the fail-closed English translation cache, causing Netlify production builds to stop before publication.
root_cause: The content correction and the static English cache were changed in separate lineages.
decision: Every public NL copy change on a localized route must add the exact new visible string variants to the static English cache in the same candidate.
prevention: Public localized content and static English cache change atomically.
STATIC_I18N_REQUIRE_CACHE remains enabled; never bypass the fail-closed guard.
Production promotion must not be retried until the deterministic cache gap is repaired.
